title: What if humans could breathe underwater?

lines.text: What would human civilization look like if we evolved the ability to breathe underwater?
If our lungs functioned like biological gills, we could freely inhabit over seventy percent of the planet.
lines.caps: We could live across | 70% of the | *planet!

lines.text: Massive underwater cities would flourish with glowing bioluminescent lighting and submerged transport tunnels.
However, our biggest mortal threat would no longer be oxygen, but crushing hydrostatic pressure.
lines.caps: Our biggest *danger | would be crushing | *water pressure

lines.text: Diving past two hundred feet without titanium suits would still crush our ribcages and boil dissolved gases.
lines.caps: Deep dives would *crush | internal organs | instantly

lines.text: Plus, pitch black deep trenches would conceal gigantic predators we couldn't hear or outrun.
Would you trade dry land for an apartment at the bottom of the Atlantic Ocean?
lines.caps: Would you move | to the *ocean floor? | Comment below!
